description: Short non-looping reaction clip for a character (celebration, laugh, anger, surprise, defeat, mischievous). Identity preserved, motion stronger than idle but still contained.
positive: single short character reaction, expressive face, upper body reacts, exact same character design, same clothing, same colors, same facial features, animated cartoon character
negative: deformation, extra limbs, extra fingers, changing clothes, color shift, morphing, identity change, camera movement, camera zoom, new accessories, new objects, background changes, text, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality
